boards.title: Your First Weekend at Grand Valley State University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A walkable, under-21-safe Allendale Campus sequence that mixes orientation, recreation, study, arts, and a campus event check-in.

cards.title: Start at Kirkhof Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • campus hub
cards.notes: Use the centrally located student union as your first indoor waypoint: orient yourself, find the information desk, and scan its gathering spaces before choosing the next stop.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a campus hub built for gathering, events, dining, and study.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU describes Kirkhof Center as centrally located on the Allendale campus and equipped with event spaces, study lounges, a game room/movie theatre, dining options, and an information desk.
cards.access_notes: Campus facility; event and service availability can vary.

cards.title: Find a library landing spot
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • 1 Campus Drive
cards.notes: Walk next door to the library, choose an open study space, and make a low-pressure plan for the week using the building’s services and campus information.
cards.short_summary: A nearby study stop with peer-help and technology resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mary Idema Pew Library is on the Allendale Campus near Cook Carillon Tower, and study spaces are available whenever the library is open.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours before visiting; study spaces are available while open.

cards.title: Step outside by the carillon
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • near the library
cards.notes: Head outside near the library for a visible campus landmark and a breather between indoor stops; use it as an easy meet-up point for your group.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed landmark beside the library area.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU identifies the Mary Idema Pew Library as being near Cook Carillon Tower on the Allendale Campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark on campus; follow posted campus guidance.

cards.title: Cross Little Mac Bridge
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • over the ravines
cards.notes: Take the bridge at an unhurried pace and pause only where circulation allows; it links campus sides and offers a simple, outdoors-first transition toward the arboretum.
cards.short_summary: A pedestrian bridge connecting two sides of campus over the ravines.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU’s Allendale scavenger hunt states that Little Mac Bridge connects two sides of campus over the Grand Ravines.
cards.access_notes: Pedestrian route; use normal caution and keep clear of other walkers.

cards.title: Take an arboretum loop
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • Allendale Campus
cards.notes: Continue from the bridge into the arboretum for a calm walk; pick out a few tree varieties and return before dark if you are unfamiliar with the paths.
cards.short_summary: A seven-acre campus collection with hundreds of trees.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU reports that its Allendale Campus arboretum covers seven acres and contains 700 trees representing 200 species or varieties.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus area; visit during comfortable daylight conditions.

cards.title: Try an open-climb session
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Fieldhouse B170
cards.notes: If the posted schedule matches your weekend, arrive for open climb, ask staff about beginner expectations, and choose bouldering or another appropriate activity at your comfort level.
cards.short_summary: An indoor climbing facility with published open-climb hours and changing routes.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU’s Climbing Center lists open-climb hours, describes bouldering, and is located at 1 Campus Drive in Fieldhouse B170, Allendale.
cards.access_notes: Current fall/winter hours list Friday 1–7 p.m. and Saturday 1–5 p.m.; confirm closures and eligibility before going.

cards.entity_name: GVSU Art Gallery at the Performing Arts Center
cards.title: Look for an art exhibition
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Check the gallery’s current exhibition information, then make a focused visit: choose one artwork or installation to discuss rather than trying to take in everything at once.
cards.short_summary: An Allendale exhibition venue within the Performing Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU states that the Allendale campus houses the Art Gallery in the Performing Arts Center.
cards.access_notes: Exhibition availability varies; verify the current gallery schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Book a skills check-in
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Mary Idema Pew Library
cards.notes: Bring one course question, draft, or research idea to a peer consultation; an early, short session can turn an unfamiliar assignment into a clear next action.
cards.short_summary: Peer consultants offer one-on-one support for research projects.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU says research consultants meet students online or in person at the Mary Idema Pew Library in Allendale for one-on-one 30-minute consultations.
cards.access_notes: Consultant hours on the official page list weekday availability; use the appointment or drop-in options shown there.

cards.title: Check the stadium calendar
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening • athletics venue
cards.notes: Before making plans, check the official athletics calendar for a game or campus program at the stadium; attend only if the listed event, ticketing, and entry details fit your plans.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed Allendale athletics venue that hosts campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: A GVSU Student Life feature identifies Lubbers Stadium as a campus location and describes a movie shown on its big screen.
cards.source_title: Choose Your Own Adventure: Find Louie!
cards.access_notes: Event availability and admission requirements vary; consult the official event listing before traveling to the venue.

cards.title: Save a future clubs night
cards.subtitle: Sunday planning • Office of Student Life
cards.notes: Use Sunday to bookmark Campus Life Night for its next occurrence and make a short list of organizations you want to meet; it is coordinated through GVSU Student Life.
cards.short_summary: A GVSU Student Life program for connecting with campus organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU states that Campus Life Night is coordinated by the Office of Student Life, a department within the Division of Student Affairs.
cards.access_notes: Recurring timing and location are not stated here; check the official page for the next scheduled program.
